title: On this day in space! Nov. 19, 2005: Japan's Hayabusa spacecraft makes 1st-ever liftoff from surface of an asteroid
caption:
In 2005 Japan’s Hayabusa became the first probe to launch itself off an asteroid, later delivering dust samples back to Earth and inspiring Hayabusa‑2.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Nov. 19, 2005: Japan's Hayabusa spacecraft makes 1st-ever liftoff from surface of an asteroid
